summary: Silver Bow Mining filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, announcing receipt of court approval and completion of the first closing in its acquisition of Montana Goldfields, Inc. and Montana Tunnels Mining, Inc. The filing also notes a forthcoming shareholder meeting to approve issuance of CVRs and underlying common shares, with a proxy statement to be filed. No price per share, stake, premium, or expected close date was disclosed. The deal involves a contingent value right structure requiring shareholder approval. Watch for proxy filing, shareholder vote timing, and any regulatory or closing conditions affecting the remaining closings.
